### u5-l3 SECONDFPN：从 3D 特征到多尺度 BEV 特征

SECONDFPN 是 SECOND backbone 与 Anchor3DHead 之间的 neck：把多尺度 BEV 特征对齐到同一分辨率后沿通道维 concat，输出单级大通道特征图（单元素列表），而非经典 FPN 的相加融合与多级输出。每条支路（deblock）=采样层+归一化+ReLU 三件套：stride>1 走 kernel=stride 的反卷积，实现整数倍无重叠上采样；stride<1（如 0.5）换算成普通卷积下采样，CenterPoint 以 upsample_strides=[0.5,1,2] 把汇聚点选在中间分辨率以省算力。norm_cfg 可配（默认 BN，可换 GN），激活函数硬编码为 ReLU 不可配置。两条硬契约：neck 输入通道逐元素等于 backbone 输出通道；head 的 in_channels 必须等于各支路 out_channels 之和。调用链上 VoxelNet.extract_feat 经 with_neck 调用 neck，其输出由 Anchor3DHead 按「多尺度特征列表」契约逐级消费，训练时按各级 featmap_sizes 生成 anchor 网格，衔接下一讲的 3D 锚框生成。
### u5-l4 Anchor3DHead 与 3D 锚框生成

本讲拆解 anchor-based 3D 检测头的三个核心模块（SECOND、PointPillars 等共用）。Anchor3DRangeGenerator 把 ranges（位置）、sizes（尺寸）、rotations（朝向）做笛卡尔积铺满 BEV 网格，anchor 总数＝H×W×尺寸数×朝向数（SECOND KITTI 下为 844800），anchor 的 z 语义是底面中心，Aligned 变体修复格点错位。DeltaXYZWLHRBBoxCoder 规定回归目标：z 先换几何中心再作差、位移按 BEV 对角线与高度归一、尺寸取 log 比，encode/decode 严格互逆，零差值解码回 anchor 自身。Anchor3DHead 仅含分类（A×C）、回归（A×7）、方向（A×2）三个 1×1 卷积分支；FocalLoss 走隐式背景并配 PseudoSampler，回归与方向损失只作用于正样本。角度两大难题分别由正弦差回归（消除 2π 周期）与方向二分类（解决 π 头尾歧义）化解，推理时经 limit_period 折叠加 dir_offset 修正拼回完整 yaw。
### u5-l5 CenterPoint：Anchor-free 的中心点范式

本讲剖析 CenterPoint 的 anchor-free 中心点范式：不预铺海量 anchor、不做 IoU 正负样本分配，而是让每个 BEV 格子预测自己是否为物体中心。CenterPoint 检测器是薄壳，复用 MVXTwoStageDetector 的柱体特征链路（PillarFeatureNet→Scatter→SECOND→SECONDFPN），仅把头换成 CenterHead；头按类别分成 6 个任务子头，每个子头内 SeparateHead 又分 heatmap/reg/height/dim/rot/vel 六个独立分支。训练目标由 get_targets 现场编码：gt 中心画高斯热图（半径随物体尺寸、重叠取 max），并生成 10 维回归目标（亚格子偏移、重心高度、log 尺寸、sin/cos 朝向、速度）；损失为 GaussianFocalLoss 加只在中心格计算的 L1，天然无需 assigner/sampler。推理由 CenterPointBBoxCoder 两级 topK 提取峰值、把格子坐标换算回米制、atan2 还原 yaw，再经 rotate 或 circle NMS 去重，合并六任务并把 z 从重心换回底面中心。
### u5-l6 任务模块：BBox Coder、3D Assigner 与 Sampler

本讲精读 `task_modules` 的训练目标生产线：IoU 计算器算重叠 → Assigner 定身份 → Sampler 挑下标 → BBox Coder 编码回归目标。这些组件无参数、注册于 `TASK_UTILS`，标准调用现场是 `train_mixins` 的 `anchor_target_single_assigner`，返回与 anchor 等长的打表式 8 元组目标。核心结论：`Max3DIoUAssigner` 只重写准备阶段，四步准则继承自 mmdet——IoU 达 `pos_iou_thr` 为正、全部低于 `neg_iou_thr` 为负、其间是忽略带，第 4 步低质量匹配受 `min_pos_iou` 约束保证每个 gt 有正样本；`AssignResult.gt_inds` 以 0 为负、正整数 k 指向第 k−1 个 gt、−1 为忽略；`SamplingResult` 由 pos_inds/neg_inds 派生 pos_gt_bboxes 等（查 gt 需减一）。两种编码哲学对比：`DeltaXYZWLHRBBoxCoder` 回归相对 anchor 的连续偏移并显式换算底面/几何中心；`PartialBinBasedBBoxCoder`（VoteNet 系）把尺寸、朝向拆成 bin 分类加残差，中心取 gravity_center 且 decode 不修正，往返误差恰为 z 列 h/2。FocalLoss 配不采样的 PseudoSampler，`IoUNegPiecewiseSampler` 供两阶段按 IoU 分段抽负样本；VoteNet 以 chamfer 距离匹配替代 assigner。
### u5-l7 3D 损失函数与 NMS

本讲讲解 mmdet3d 三个原生损失与五种 3D 去重后处理。损失均为「无参 nn.Module 壳 + weighted_loss 装饰的裸函数」双层结构，加权与规约由装饰器统一处理，且都属于配对后的对齐 IoU 计算。RotatedIoU3DLoss 处理 7 维旋转框，依赖 mmcv 的 CUDA 可微算子，仅 GPU 可用；AxisAlignedIoULoss 面向室内 6 维对角点框，纯 PyTorch 实现并支持 GIoU 模式；MultiBinLoss 以「bin 分类 + sin/cos 残差回归」化解角度周期性，源码因 return 缩进在循环内而实际只累计第一个 bin。去重方面：box3d_multiclass_nms 逐类调度，按 use_rotate_nms 分派旋转的 nms_bev 与轴对齐的 nms_normal_bev（承接 0.x 旧接口）；aligned_3d_nms 为类别感知的室内体积 NMS；circle_nms 用中心平方距离替代 IoU，阈值需按平方理解。选型直觉：anchor 系用旋转 BEV NMS，室内点云用轴对齐 NMS，CenterPoint 等中心点范式偏爱 circle NMS。
### u6-l1 PointNet++ 系列骨干网络

本讲梳理 PointNet++ 系列点路线骨干：与体素路线（单元 5）相对，不栅格化点云，感受野由米制 radius 显式给出。核心是 SA 模块（Set Abstraction，集合抽象）的采样—分组—聚合三步：FPS 选中心、球查询取邻域、共享 MLP 加邻居维池化，集合运算统一伪装成 (1,1) Conv2d。BasePointNet 固化 (B,N,3+C) 输入契约，特征切分为 (B,C,N) 布局。PointNet2SASSG 是 SA 下采样塔加 FP 上采样（3 近邻距离倒数加权插值）的 U 形骨干，VoteNet 取其末级 1024 个 seed 点供投票；PointNet2SAMSG 无 FP 塔，用多尺度分组、D-FPS/F-FPS/FS 采样、膨胀球壳与聚合压缩，服务 3DSSD/PointRCNN。另介绍变长堆叠、中心点外部给定的 StackedSAModuleMSG（PV-RCNN 关键点分支）与 PointNetFPNeck。骨干输出 dict 而非列表，各级通道可由 skip_channel_list 纸面推导。
### u6-l2 VoteNet：基于投票的室内检测端到端解析

本讲端到端解析室内点云检测器 VoteNet。核心思想是投票（vote）：室内物体只有表面点、几何中心悬空，故让每个表面点（object coordinate）回归指向物体中心（center coordinate）的偏移，票在中心聚簇后再分类回归，且全程采用几何中心口径。前向链路四步：VoteModule 由种子点生成投票点与残差特征；PointSAModule 聚合成提案（训练在投票点上采样、测试在种子点上采样）；BaseConvBboxHead 打分；PartialBinBasedBBoxCoder 解码。VoteNet 无 anchor 与 assigner，提案与真值靠 Chamfer 最近邻匹配，距离小于 0.3 为正、大于 0.6 为负、中间忽略带不计损失；共八项损失，center 损失为双向 Chamfer。推理依次做空框过滤（框内点数大于 5）、aligned_3d_nms 与 per_class_proposal（分数为 objectness 乘语义概率）。检测器为薄壳，重写 loss/predict 仅为把原始点云传入 VoteHead 以生成投票监督。
### u6-l3 更多点云检测器：GroupFree3D、3DSSD、H3DNet

本讲对比三个 VoteNet 之后的进阶点云检测器。GroupFree3D 用 kps 前景打分选候选点，经多层 Transformer 解码器迭代精修出框，取代「投票+分组」范式，逐层深监督。3DSSD 用 F-FPS 特征距离采样保证前景覆盖，投票降为辅助分支，新增 centerness（连续中心度）、corner loss、vote loss 三项监督，推理时 objectness 直接取语义分最大值。H3DNet 为两阶段结构：VoteNet 当 RPN 产提案，RoI 阶段用 z 面、xy 面、line 边三类几何基元匹配提案的 6 面心与 12 边心做残差精修。核心结论：室内检测器不用 IoU assigner，正负样本按「点在框内」或 Chamfer 距离分配；三者共享薄壳检测器加厚 head、gravity_center 口径与 bin-based 编码模板。
### u6-l4 两阶段检测器与 RoI Heads：Part-A2 与 PV-RCNN

本讲剖析两阶段 3D 检测框架：TwoStage3DDetector 把「RPN 出提案、RoI head 精修」串成完整训练与推理链路，train_cfg 按 rpn、rpn_proposal、rcnn 三段注入各组件；roi_heads 子系统由基类骨架、roi_extractors 特征提取器与 bbox_heads 回归头三层组成。Part-A2 用逐体素语义头做前景分割与部位回归，part_feats 经 feats_dict 耦合进 RoI 分支，RoIAwarePool3d 把 RoI 内点重栅格化为 14³ 网格（point→voxel），再由稀疏卷积 bbox head 精修，训练目标为 IoU 软标签、canonical 变换编码与 corner loss 三件套。PV-RCNN 的 VoxelSetAbstraction 以 FPS 关键点做三源特征融合，Batch3DRoIGridExtractor 用 6³ 网格点球查询聚合 RoI 特征。核心结论：Part-A2 池化 RoI 内部的点，PV-RCNN 池化全局关键点，这是二者 RoI 特征来源的本质差异。
### u6-l5 单目 3D 检测：FCOS3D、SMOKE 与相机坐标系

本讲介绍单目 3D 检测：仅凭单张图像输出相机系 3D 框，深度本质不确定，只能靠统计先验与相机内参约束。检测器极薄：SingleStageMono3DDetector 跨库继承 mmdet 一阶段检测器，只补 imgs 取图与 3D/2D 双契约写回，算法集中在 head 与 coder。FCOS3D 走逐像素范式：9 维回归按 group_reg_dims 拆成偏移/深度/尺寸/朝向/速度五组，深度尺寸用 exp（或先验线性）解码，全局朝向=视线角+局部朝向；SMOKE 走热图范式：局部极大值检出免 NMS，经 trans_mat 与内参逆解析反投影，训练用角点 L1 损失。数据契约新增 centers_2d 与 depths，管线与解码器配套设计。
### u6-l6 多模态融合检测：MVXNet 与 mmdet 组件复用

本讲以 MVXNet 剖析多模态融合与 mmdet 组件复用。MVXTwoStageDetector 用 pts_*/img_* 可选槽位积木式装配双分支；动态体素化下 voxels 即原始点，聚合推迟到网络内 DynamicScatter，故 DynamicMVXFasterRCNN 重写 extract_pts_feat。核心结论：点级融合插在 DynamicVFE 末层——PointFusion 将点经「逆 3D 增强（按 transformation_3d_flow 倒序重放）→ lidar2img 投影 → 正向 2D 增强 → grid_sample」三重坐标变换采得图像特征，与点特征相加后随点聚合进体素；两分支唯一汇合点是 extract_feat 把 img_feats 传入点云分支。配置仅借用 mmdet 五处（ResNet、FPN 及三个损失函数），未配 2D 检测头，图像分支是纯「特征捐赠者」，3D 损失全来自 Anchor3DHead。关键术语：点级融合、动态体素化、lidar2img、特征捐赠者——其中点级融合区别于 BEVFusion 的 BEV 级融合，为后续对照埋线。
### u7-l1 train.py 与 Runner 训练全流程

本讲剖析 mmdet3d 的训练全流程。核心结论：tools/train.py 是「薄入口」，不含训练逻辑，只做解析参数、Config.fromfile 合并配置、按 CLI 改写配置（--amp 换用 AmpOptimWrapper 开混合精度、--resume 自动找最新断点续训并覆盖 load_from、--cfg-options 深度合并），再把配置交给 Runner.from_cfg 组装模型、dataloader、优化器包装器与 hook 等组件，启动 runner.train() 主循环。日程基座 cyclic-40e 用两段余弦 param_scheduler 让学习率与动量反向变化并逐 iter 连续生效，梯度裁剪是 OptimWrapper 的职责，RepeatDataset 使真实数据轮数等于 max_epochs 乘 times。运行时基座 default_runtime 提供六个默认 hook（计时、日志、推进调度器、存档、分布式种子、3D 可视化）与窗口平滑的 LogProcessor。主循环每 iter 依次执行 hook 计时、model.train_step（内含 data_preprocessor 与 loss 计算）、推进 lr 并记日志，每隔 val_interval 轮跑 ValLoop 输出 mAP。work_dir 产出日志、vis_data/scalars.json 与 checkpoint；日志中 time 与 data_time 之比是判断数据瓶颈还是算力瓶颈的第一依据。
### u7-l2 test.py 与评估指标体系

本讲讲解 tools/test.py 测试入口与 mmdet3d 评估指标体系。test.py 是薄入口，只按命令行改写配置（checkpoint、work_dir、可视化、TTA）后交给 runner.test()；关键辨析：命令行 --score-thr 只进可视化 hook，而 model.test_cfg.score_thr 在 box3d_multiclass_nms 前过滤预测，才真正影响 mAP。8 个 metric 类均继承 BaseMetric 两段式契约：process 逐批把预测攒为 CPU 结果、compute_metrics 全量结算，因 AP 需全数据集统一排序；format_only 可只转官方提交格式。NuScenesMetric 走官方 devkit 路线，按 BEV 中心距离（0.5/1/2/4 米）匹配，输出 mAP、五类 TP 误差（mATE/mASE/mAOE/mAVE/mAAE）与 NDS，LiDAR 模型属性由速度启发式兜底。KittiMetric 为自研 numba 实现：预测与真值均转回 KITTI 原生九字段，按图像高度、遮挡、截断分 easy/moderate/hard 三档，strict/loose 双 IoU 阈值，41 点 PR 单调化得 AP11/AP40，纯 LiDAR 的 2D AP 来自 3D 框投影。其余 Waymo 调官方 C++ 二进制、Lyft 走 devkit、室内指标复用 indoor_eval（3D IoU@0.25/0.5）。

# Copyright (c) OpenMMLab. All rights reserved.
import os.path as osp
import warnings
from typing import Optional, Sequence

import mmcv
import numpy as np
from mmengine.fileio import get
from mmengine.hooks import Hook
from mmengine.logging import print_log
from mmengine.runner import Runner
from mmengine.utils import mkdir_or_exist
from mmengine.visualization import Visualizer

from mmdet3d.registry import HOOKS
from mmdet3d.structures import Det3DDataSample


@HOOKS.register_module()
class Det3DVisualizationHook(Hook):
    """Detection Visualization Hook. Used to visualize validation and testing
    process prediction results.

    In the testing phase:

    1. If ``show`` is True, it means that only the prediction results are
        visualized without storing data, so ``vis_backends`` needs to
        be excluded.
    2. If ``test_out_dir`` is specified, it means that the prediction results
        need to be saved to ``test_out_dir``. In order to avoid vis_backends
        also storing data, so ``vis_backends`` needs to be excluded.
    3. ``vis_backends`` takes effect if the user does not specify ``show``
        and `test_out_dir``. You can set ``vis_backends`` to WandbVisBackend or
        TensorboardVisBackend to store the prediction result in Wandb or
        Tensorboard.

    Args:
        draw (bool): whether to draw prediction results. If it is False,
            it means that no drawing will be done. Defaults to False.
        interval (int): The interval of visualization. Defaults to 50.
        score_thr (float): The threshold to visualize the bboxes
            and masks. Defaults to 0.3.
        show (bool): Whether to display the drawn image. Default to False.
        vis_task (str): Visualization task. Defaults to 'mono_det'.
        wait_time (float): The interval of show (s). Defaults to 0.
        draw_gt (bool): Whether to draw ground truth. Defaults to True.
        draw_pred (bool): Whether to draw prediction. Defaults to True.
        show_pcd_rgb (bool): Whether to show RGB point cloud. Defaults to
            False.
        test_out_dir (str, optional): directory where painted images
            will be saved in testing process.
        backend_args (dict, optional): Arguments to instantiate the
            corresponding backend. Defaults to None.
    """

    def __init__(self,
                 draw: bool = False,
                 interval: int = 50,
                 score_thr: float = 0.3,
                 show: bool = False,
                 vis_task: str = 'mono_det',
                 wait_time: float = 0.,
                 test_out_dir: Optional[str] = None,
                 draw_gt: bool = False,
                 draw_pred: bool = True,
                 show_pcd_rgb: bool = False,
                 backend_args: Optional[dict] = None):
        self._visualizer: Visualizer = Visualizer.get_current_instance()
        self.interval = interval
        self.score_thr = score_thr
        self.show = show
        if self.show:
            # No need to think about vis backends.
            self._visualizer._vis_backends = {}
            warnings.warn('The show is True, it means that only '
                          'the prediction results are visualized '
                          'without storing data, so vis_backends '
                          'needs to be excluded.')
        self.vis_task = vis_task

        if show and wait_time == -1:
            print_log(
                'Manual control mode, press [Right] to next sample.',
                logger='current')
        elif show:
            print_log(
                'Autoplay mode, press [SPACE] to pause.', logger='current')
        self.wait_time = wait_time
        self.backend_args = backend_args
        self.draw = draw
        self.test_out_dir = test_out_dir
        self._test_index = 0
        self.draw_gt = draw_gt
        self.draw_pred = draw_pred
        self.show_pcd_rgb = show_pcd_rgb

    def after_val_iter(self, runner: Runner, batch_idx: int, data_batch: dict,
                       outputs: Sequence[Det3DDataSample]) -> None:
        """Run after every ``self.interval`` validation iterations.

        Args:
            runner (:obj:`Runner`): The runner of the validation process.
            batch_idx (int): The index of the current batch in the val loop.
            data_batch (dict): Data from dataloader.
            outputs (Sequence[:obj:`DetDataSample`]]): A batch of data samples
                that contain annotations and predictions.
        """
        if self.draw is False:
            return

        # There is no guarantee that the same batch of images
        # is visualized for each evaluation.
        total_curr_iter = runner.iter + batch_idx

        data_input = dict()

        # Visualize only the first data
        if self.vis_task in [
                'mono_det', 'multi-view_det', 'multi-modality_det'
        ]:
            assert 'img_path' in outputs[0], 'img_path is not in outputs[0]'
            img_path = outputs[0].img_path
            if isinstance(img_path, list):
                img = []
                for single_img_path in img_path:
                    img_bytes = get(
                        single_img_path, backend_args=self.backend_args)
                    single_img = mmcv.imfrombytes(
                        img_bytes, channel_order='rgb')
                    img.append(single_img)
            else:
                img_bytes = get(img_path, backend_args=self.backend_args)
                img = mmcv.imfrombytes(img_bytes, channel_order='rgb')
            data_input['img'] = img

        if self.vis_task in ['lidar_det', 'multi-modality_det', 'lidar_seg']:
            assert 'lidar_path' in outputs[
                0], 'lidar_path is not in outputs[0]'
            lidar_path = outputs[0].lidar_path
            num_pts_feats = outputs[0].num_pts_feats
            pts_bytes = get(lidar_path, backend_args=self.backend_args)
            points = np.frombuffer(pts_bytes, dtype=np.float32)
            points = points.reshape(-1, num_pts_feats)
            data_input['points'] = points

        if total_curr_iter % self.interval == 0:
            self._visualizer.add_datasample(
                'val sample',
                data_input,
                data_sample=outputs[0],
                draw_gt=self.draw_gt,
                draw_pred=self.draw_pred,
                show=self.show,
                vis_task=self.vis_task,
                wait_time=self.wait_time,
                pred_score_thr=self.score_thr,
                step=total_curr_iter,
                show_pcd_rgb=self.show_pcd_rgb)

    def after_test_iter(self, runner: Runner, batch_idx: int, data_batch: dict,
                        outputs: Sequence[Det3DDataSample]) -> None:
        """Run after every testing iterations.

        Args:
            runner (:obj:`Runner`): The runner of the testing process.
            batch_idx (int): The index of the current batch in the val loop.
            data_batch (dict): Data from dataloader.
            outputs (Sequence[:obj:`DetDataSample`]): A batch of data samples
                that contain annotations and predictions.
        """
        if self.draw is False:
            return

        if self.test_out_dir is not None:
            self.test_out_dir = osp.join(runner.work_dir, runner.timestamp,
                                         self.test_out_dir)
            mkdir_or_exist(self.test_out_dir)

        for data_sample in outputs:
            self._test_index += 1

            data_input = dict()
            assert 'img_path' in data_sample or 'lidar_path' in data_sample, \
                "'data_sample' must contain 'img_path' or 'lidar_path'"

            out_file = o3d_save_path = None

            if self.vis_task in [
                    'mono_det', 'multi-view_det', 'multi-modality_det'
            ]:
                assert 'img_path' in data_sample, \
                    'img_path is not in data_sample'
                img_path = data_sample.img_path
                if isinstance(img_path, list):
                    img = []
                    for single_img_path in img_path:
                        img_bytes = get(
                            single_img_path, backend_args=self.backend_args)
                        single_img = mmcv.imfrombytes(
                            img_bytes, channel_order='rgb')
                        img.append(single_img)
                else:
                    img_bytes = get(img_path, backend_args=self.backend_args)
                    img = mmcv.imfrombytes(img_bytes, channel_order='rgb')
                data_input['img'] = img
                if self.test_out_dir is not None:
                    if isinstance(img_path, list):
                        img_path = img_path[0]
                    out_file = osp.basename(img_path)
                    out_file = osp.join(self.test_out_dir, out_file)

            if self.vis_task in [
                    'lidar_det', 'multi-modality_det', 'lidar_seg'
            ]:
                assert 'lidar_path' in data_sample, \
                    'lidar_path is not in data_sample'
                lidar_path = data_sample.lidar_path
                num_pts_feats = data_sample.num_pts_feats
                pts_bytes = get(lidar_path, backend_args=self.backend_args)
                points = np.frombuffer(pts_bytes, dtype=np.float32)
                points = points.reshape(-1, num_pts_feats)
                data_input['points'] = points
                if self.test_out_dir is not None:
                    o3d_save_path = osp.basename(lidar_path).split(
                        '.')[0] + '.png'
                    o3d_save_path = osp.join(self.test_out_dir, o3d_save_path)

            self._visualizer.add_datasample(
                'test sample',
                data_input,
                data_sample=data_sample,
                draw_gt=self.draw_gt,
                draw_pred=self.draw_pred,
                show=self.show,
                vis_task=self.vis_task,
                wait_time=self.wait_time,
                pred_score_thr=self.score_thr,
                out_file=out_file,
                o3d_save_path=o3d_save_path,
                step=self._test_index,
                show_pcd_rgb=self.show_pcd_rgb)

413	            face_colors (str or Tuple[int] or List[str or Tuple[int]]):
414	                The face colors. Defaults to 'none'.
415	            alpha (int or float): The transparency of bboxes. Defaults to 1.
416	        """
417	
418	        check_type('bboxes', bboxes_3d, BaseInstance3DBoxes)
419	        bev_bboxes = tensor2ndarray(bboxes_3d.bev)
420	        # scale the bev bboxes for better visualization
421	        bev_bboxes[:, :4] *= scale
422	        ctr, w, h, theta = np.split(bev_bboxes, [2, 3, 4], axis=-1)
423	        cos_value, sin_value = np.cos(theta), np.sin(theta)
424	        vec1 = np.concatenate([w / 2 * cos_value, w / 2 * sin_value], axis=-1)
425	        vec2 = np.concatenate([-h / 2 * sin_value, h / 2 * cos_value], axis=-1)
426	        pt1 = ctr + vec1 + vec2
427	        pt2 = ctr + vec1 - vec2
428	        pt3 = ctr - vec1 - vec2
429	        pt4 = ctr - vec1 + vec2
430	        poly = np.stack([pt1, pt2, pt3, pt4], axis=-2)
431	        # move the object along x-axis
432	        poly[:, :, 0] += self.width / 2
433	        poly = [p for p in poly]
434	        return self.draw_polygons(
435	            poly,
436	            alpha=alpha,
437	            edge_colors=edge_colors,
438	            line_styles=line_styles,
439	            line_widths=line_widths,
440	            face_colors=face_colors)

479	    @master_only
480	    def draw_proj_bboxes_3d(
481	            self,
482	            bboxes_3d: BaseInstance3DBoxes,
483	            input_meta: dict,
484	            edge_colors: Union[str, Tuple[int],
485	                               List[Union[str, Tuple[int]]]] = 'royalblue',
486	            line_styles: Union[str, List[str]] = '-',
487	            line_widths: Union[int, float, List[Union[int, float]]] = 2,
488	            face_colors: Union[str, Tuple[int],
489	                               List[Union[str, Tuple[int]]]] = 'royalblue',
490	            alpha: Union[int, float] = 0.4,
491	            img_size: Optional[Tuple] = None):
492	        """Draw projected 3D boxes on the image.
493	
494	        Args:
495	            bboxes_3d (:obj:`BaseInstance3DBoxes`): 3D bbox
496	                (x, y, z, x_size, y_size, z_size, yaw) to visualize.
497	            input_meta (dict): Input meta information.
498	            edge_colors (str or Tuple[int] or List[str or Tuple[int]]):
499	                The colors of bboxes. ``colors`` can have the same length with
500	                lines or just single value. If ``colors`` is single value, all
501	                the lines will have the same colors. Refer to `matplotlib.
502	                colors` for full list of formats that are accepted.
503	                Defaults to 'royalblue'.
504	            line_styles (str or List[str]): The linestyle of lines.
505	                ``line_styles`` can have the same length with texts or just
506	                single value. If ``line_styles`` is single value, all the lines
507	                will have the same linestyle. Reference to
508	                https://matplotlib.org/stable/api/collections_api.html?highlight=collection#matplotlib.collections.AsteriskPolygonCollection.set_linestyle
509	                for more details. Defaults to '-'.
510	            line_widths (int or float or List[int or float]): The linewidth of
511	                lines. ``line_widths`` can have the same length with lines or
512	                just single value. If ``line_widths`` is single value, all the
513	                lines will have the same linewidth. Defaults to 2.
514	            face_colors (str or Tuple[int] or List[str or Tuple[int]]):
515	                The face colors. Defaults to 'royalblue'.
516	            alpha (int or float): The transparency of bboxes. Defaults to 0.4.
517	            img_size (tuple, optional): The size (w, h) of the image.
518	        """
519	
520	        check_type('bboxes', bboxes_3d, BaseInstance3DBoxes)
521	
522	        if isinstance(bboxes_3d, DepthInstance3DBoxes):
523	            proj_bbox3d_to_img = proj_depth_bbox3d_to_img
524	        elif isinstance(bboxes_3d, LiDARInstance3DBoxes):
525	            proj_bbox3d_to_img = proj_lidar_bbox3d_to_img
526	        elif isinstance(bboxes_3d, CameraInstance3DBoxes):
527	            proj_bbox3d_to_img = proj_camera_bbox3d_to_img
528	        else:
529	            raise NotImplementedError('unsupported box type!')
530	
531	        edge_colors_norm = color_val_matplotlib(edge_colors)
532	
533	        corners_2d = proj_bbox3d_to_img(bboxes_3d, input_meta)
534	        if img_size is not None:
535	            # Filter out the bbox where half of stuff is outside the image.
536	            # This is for the visualization of multi-view image.
537	            valid_point_idx = (corners_2d[..., 0] >= 0) & \
538	                        (corners_2d[..., 0] <= img_size[0]) & \
539	                        (corners_2d[..., 1] >= 0) & (corners_2d[..., 1] <= img_size[1])  # noqa: E501
540	            valid_bbox_idx = valid_point_idx.sum(axis=-1) >= 4
541	            corners_2d = corners_2d[valid_bbox_idx]
542	            filter_edge_colors = []
543	            filter_edge_colors_norm = []
544	            for i, color in enumerate(edge_colors):
545	                if valid_bbox_idx[i]:
546	                    filter_edge_colors.append(color)
547	                    filter_edge_colors_norm.append(edge_colors_norm[i])
548	            edge_colors = filter_edge_colors
549	            edge_colors_norm = filter_edge_colors_norm
550	
551	        lines_verts_idx = [0, 1, 2, 3, 7, 6, 5, 4, 0, 3, 7, 4, 5, 1, 2, 6]
552	        lines_verts = corners_2d[:, lines_verts_idx, :]
553	        front_polys = corners_2d[:, 4:, :]
554	        codes = [Path.LINETO] * lines_verts.shape[1]
555	        codes[0] = Path.MOVETO
556	        pathpatches = []
557	        for i in range(len(corners_2d)):
558	            verts = lines_verts[i]
559	            pth = Path(verts, codes)
560	            pathpatches.append(PathPatch(pth))
561	
562	        p = PatchCollection(
563	            pathpatches,
564	            facecolors='none',
565	            edgecolors=edge_colors_norm,
566	            linewidths=line_widths,
567	            linestyles=line_styles)
568	
569	        self.ax_save.add_collection(p)
570	
571	        # draw a mask on the front of project bboxes
572	        front_polys = [front_poly for front_poly in front_polys]
573	        return self.draw_polygons(
574	            front_polys,
575	            alpha=alpha,
576	            edge_colors=edge_colors,
577	            line_styles=line_styles,
578	            line_widths=line_widths,
579	            face_colors=edge_colors)

583	        """Add segmentation mask to visualizer via per-point colorization.
584	
585	        Args:
586	            seg_mask_colors (np.ndarray): The segmentation mask with shape
587	                (N, 6), whose first 3 dims are point coordinates and last 3
588	                dims are converted colors.
589	        """
590	        # we can't draw the colors on existing points
591	        # in case gt and pred mask would overlap
592	        # instead we set a large offset along x-axis for each seg mask
593	        if hasattr(self, 'pcd'):
594	            offset = (np.array(self.pcd.points).max(0) -

602	        seg_points = copy.deepcopy(seg_mask_colors)
603	        seg_points[:, 0] += offset
604	        self.set_points(seg_points, pcd_mode=2, vis_mode='add', mode='xyzrgb')

606	    def _draw_instances_3d(self,
607	                           data_input: dict,
608	                           instances: InstanceData,
609	                           input_meta: dict,
610	                           vis_task: str,
611	                           show_pcd_rgb: bool = False,
612	                           palette: Optional[List[tuple]] = None) -> dict:
613	        """Draw 3D instances of GT or prediction.
614	
615	        Args:
616	            data_input (dict): The input dict to draw.
617	            instances (:obj:`InstanceData`): Data structure for instance-level
618	                annotations or predictions.
619	            input_meta (dict): Meta information.
620	            vis_task (str): Visualization task, it includes: 'lidar_det',
621	                'multi-modality_det', 'mono_det'.
622	            show_pcd_rgb (bool): Whether to show RGB point cloud.
623	            palette (List[tuple], optional): Palette information corresponding
624	                to the category. Defaults to None.
625	
626	        Returns:
627	            dict: The drawn point cloud and image whose channel is RGB.
628	        """
629	
630	        # Only visualize when there is at least one instance
631	        if not len(instances) > 0:
632	            return None
633	
634	        bboxes_3d = instances.bboxes_3d  # BaseInstance3DBoxes
635	        labels_3d = instances.labels_3d
636	
637	        data_3d = dict()
638	
639	        if vis_task in ['lidar_det', 'multi-modality_det']:
640	            assert 'points' in data_input
641	            points = data_input['points']
642	            check_type('points', points, (np.ndarray, Tensor))
643	            points = tensor2ndarray(points)
644	
645	            if not isinstance(bboxes_3d, DepthInstance3DBoxes):
646	                points, bboxes_3d_depth = to_depth_mode(points, bboxes_3d)
647	            else:
648	                bboxes_3d_depth = bboxes_3d.clone()
649	
650	            if 'axis_align_matrix' in input_meta:
651	                points = DepthPoints(points, points_dim=points.shape[1])
652	                rot_mat = input_meta['axis_align_matrix'][:3, :3]
653	                trans_vec = input_meta['axis_align_matrix'][:3, -1]
654	                points.rotate(rot_mat.T)
655	                points.translate(trans_vec)
656	                points = tensor2ndarray(points.tensor)
657	
658	            max_label = int(max(labels_3d) if len(labels_3d) > 0 else 0)
659	            bbox_color = palette if self.bbox_color is None \
660	                else self.bbox_color
661	            bbox_palette = get_palette(bbox_color, max_label + 1)
662	            colors = [bbox_palette[label] for label in labels_3d]
663	
664	            self.set_points(
665	                points, pcd_mode=2, mode='xyzrgb' if show_pcd_rgb else 'xyz')
666	            self.draw_bboxes_3d(bboxes_3d_depth, bbox_color=colors)
667	
668	            data_3d['bboxes_3d'] = tensor2ndarray(bboxes_3d_depth.tensor)
669	            data_3d['points'] = points
670	
671	        if vis_task in ['mono_det', 'multi-modality_det']:
672	            assert 'img' in data_input
673	            img = data_input['img']
674	            if isinstance(img, list) or (isinstance(img, (np.ndarray, Tensor))
675	                                         and len(img.shape) == 4):
676	                # show multi-view images
677	                img_size = img[0].shape[:2] if isinstance(
678	                    img, list) else img.shape[-2:]  # noqa: E501
679	                img_col = self.multi_imgs_col
680	                img_row = math.ceil(len(img) / img_col)
681	                composed_img = np.zeros(
682	                    (img_size[0] * img_row, img_size[1] * img_col, 3),
683	                    dtype=np.uint8)
684	                for i, single_img in enumerate(img):
685	                    # Note that we should keep the same order of elements both
686	                    # in `img` and `input_meta`
687	                    if isinstance(single_img, Tensor):
688	                        single_img = single_img.permute(1, 2, 0).numpy()
689	                        single_img = single_img[..., [2, 1, 0]]  # bgr to rgb
690	                    self.set_image(single_img)
691	                    single_img_meta = dict()
692	                    for key, meta in input_meta.items():
693	                        if isinstance(meta,
694	                                      (Sequence, np.ndarray,
695	                                       Tensor)) and len(meta) == len(img):
696	                            single_img_meta[key] = meta[i]
697	                        else:
698	                            single_img_meta[key] = meta
699	
700	                    max_label = int(
701	                        max(labels_3d) if len(labels_3d) > 0 else 0)
702	                    bbox_color = palette if self.bbox_color is None \
703	                        else self.bbox_color
704	                    bbox_palette = get_palette(bbox_color, max_label + 1)
705	                    colors = [bbox_palette[label] for label in labels_3d]
706	
707	                    self.draw_proj_bboxes_3d(
708	                        bboxes_3d,
709	                        single_img_meta,
710	                        img_size=single_img.shape[:2][::-1],
711	                        edge_colors=colors)
712	                    if vis_task == 'mono_det' and hasattr(
713	                            instances, 'centers_2d'):
714	                        centers_2d = instances.centers_2d
715	                        self.draw_points(centers_2d)
716	                    composed_img[(i // img_col) *
717	                                 img_size[0]:(i // img_col + 1) * img_size[0],
718	                                 (i % img_col) *
719	                                 img_size[1]:(i % img_col + 1) *
720	                                 img_size[1]] = self.get_image()
721	                data_3d['img'] = composed_img
722	            else:
723	                # show single-view image
724	                # TODO: Solve the problem: some line segments of 3d bboxes are
725	                # out of image by a large margin
726	                if isinstance(data_input['img'], Tensor):
727	                    img = img.permute(1, 2, 0).numpy()
728	                    img = img[..., [2, 1, 0]]  # bgr to rgb
729	                self.set_image(img)
730	
731	                max_label = int(max(labels_3d) if len(labels_3d) > 0 else 0)
732	                bbox_color = palette if self.bbox_color is None \
733	                    else self.bbox_color
734	                bbox_palette = get_palette(bbox_color, max_label + 1)
735	                colors = [bbox_palette[label] for label in labels_3d]
736	
737	                self.draw_proj_bboxes_3d(
738	                    bboxes_3d, input_meta, edge_colors=colors)
739	                if vis_task == 'mono_det' and hasattr(instances, 'centers_2d'):
740	                    centers_2d = instances.centers_2d
741	                    self.draw_points(centers_2d)
742	                drawn_img = self.get_image()
743	                data_3d['img'] = drawn_img
744	
745	        return data_3d

779	    def show(self,
780	             save_path: Optional[str] = None,
781	             drawn_img_3d: Optional[np.ndarray] = None,
782	             drawn_img: Optional[np.ndarray] = None,
783	             win_name: str = 'image',
784	             wait_time: int = -1,
785	             continue_key: str = 'right',
786	             vis_task: str = 'lidar_det') -> None:
787	        """Show the drawn point cloud/image.
788	
789	        Args:
790	            save_path (str, optional): Path to save open3d visualized results.
791	                Defaults to None.
792	            drawn_img_3d (np.ndarray, optional): The image to show. If
793	                drawn_img_3d is not None, it will show the image got by
794	                Visualizer. Defaults to None.
795	            drawn_img (np.ndarray, optional): The image to show. If drawn_img
796	                is not None, it will show the image got by Visualizer.
797	                Defaults to None.
798	            win_name (str): The image title. Defaults to 'image'.
799	            wait_time (int): Delay in milliseconds. 0 is the special value that
800	                means "forever". Defaults to 0.
801	            continue_key (str): The key for users to continue. Defaults to ' '.
802	        """
803	
804	        # In order to show multi-modal results at the same time, we show image
805	        # firstly and then show point cloud since the running of
806	        # Open3D will block the process
807	        if hasattr(self, '_image'):
808	            if drawn_img is None and drawn_img_3d is None:
809	                # use the image got by Visualizer.get_image()
810	                if vis_task == 'multi-modality_det':
811	                    import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
812	                    is_inline = 'inline' in plt.get_backend()
813	                    img = self.get_image() if drawn_img is None else drawn_img
814	                    self._init_manager(win_name)
815	                    fig = self.manager.canvas.figure
816	                    # remove white edges by set subplot margin
817	                    fig.subplots_adjust(left=0, right=1, bottom=0, top=1)
818	                    fig.clear()
819	                    ax = fig.add_subplot()
820	                    ax.axis(False)
821	                    ax.imshow(img)
822	                    self.manager.canvas.draw()
823	                    if is_inline:
824	                        return fig
825	                    else:
826	                        fig.show()
827	                    self.manager.canvas.flush_events()
828	                else:
829	                    super().show(drawn_img_3d, win_name, wait_time,
830	                                 continue_key)
831	            else:
832	                if vis_task == 'multi-modality_det':
833	                    import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
834	                    is_inline = 'inline' in plt.get_backend()
835	                    img = drawn_img if drawn_img_3d is None else drawn_img_3d
836	                    self._init_manager(win_name)
837	                    fig = self.manager.canvas.figure
838	                    # remove white edges by set subplot margin
839	                    fig.subplots_adjust(left=0, right=1, bottom=0, top=1)
840	                    fig.clear()
841	                    ax = fig.add_subplot()
842	                    ax.axis(False)
843	                    ax.imshow(img)
844	                    self.manager.canvas.draw()
845	                    if is_inline:
846	                        return fig
847	                    else:
848	                        fig.show()
849	                    self.manager.canvas.flush_events()
850	                else:
851	                    if drawn_img_3d is not None:
852	                        super().show(drawn_img_3d, win_name, wait_time,
853	                                     continue_key)
854	                    if drawn_img is not None:
855	                        super().show(drawn_img, win_name, wait_time,
856	                                     continue_key)
857	
858	        if hasattr(self, 'o3d_vis'):
859	            if hasattr(self, 'view_port'):
860	                self.view_control.convert_from_pinhole_camera_parameters(
861	                    self.view_port)
862	            self.flag_exit = not self.o3d_vis.poll_events()
863	            self.o3d_vis.update_renderer()
864	            # if not hasattr(self, 'view_control'):
865	            #     self.o3d_vis.create_window()
866	            #     self.view_control = self.o3d_vis.get_view_control()
867	            self.view_port = \
868	                self.view_control.convert_to_pinhole_camera_parameters()  # noqa: E501
869	            if wait_time != -1:
870	                self.last_time = time.time()
871	                while time.time(
872	                ) - self.last_time < wait_time and self.o3d_vis.poll_events():
873	                    self.o3d_vis.update_renderer()
874	                    self.view_port = \
875	                        self.view_control.convert_to_pinhole_camera_parameters()  # noqa: E501
876	                while self.flag_pause and self.o3d_vis.poll_events():
877	                    self.o3d_vis.update_renderer()
878	                    self.view_port = \
879	                        self.view_control.convert_to_pinhole_camera_parameters()  # noqa: E501
880	
881	            else:
882	                while not self.flag_next and self.o3d_vis.poll_events():
883	                    self.o3d_vis.update_renderer()
884	                    self.view_port = \
885	                        self.view_control.convert_to_pinhole_camera_parameters()  # noqa: E501
886	                self.flag_next = False
887	            self.o3d_vis.clear_geometries()
888	            try:
889	                del self.pcd
890	            except (KeyError, AttributeError):
891	                pass
892	            if save_path is not None:
893	                if not (save_path.endswith('.png')
894	                        or save_path.endswith('.jpg')):
895	                    save_path += '.png'
896	                self.o3d_vis.capture_screen_image(save_path)
897	            if self.flag_exit:
898	                self.o3d_vis.destroy_window()
899	                self.o3d_vis.close()
900	                self._clear_o3d_vis()
901	                sys.exit(0)
